name: Case Converter
description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, tOGGLE cASE, or Capitalized Words instantly.

faq.question: What's the difference between Title Case and Capitalize Words?
faq.answer: Title Case first lowercases the whole string, then capitalizes the first letter of every word — so 'heLLo woRLd' becomes 'Hello World'. Capitalize Words only uppercases the first letter of each word and leaves the rest of each word untouched — so 'heLLo woRLd' becomes 'HeLLo WoRLd'.

faq.question: Does Sentence case handle abbreviations correctly?
faq.answer: It capitalizes the first letter after '.', '!', or '?' followed by whitespace, which covers the vast majority of normal writing but can occasionally misfire after abbreviations like 'e.g.' — review the result for text with heavy abbreviation use.

faq.question: Is my text uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No — the conversion happens instantly in your browser with plain JavaScript string methods. Nothing is sent to a server.
